node.statement: Local notation for node 1.2.2: C is conv{p_w:w in W(P)}; for each row index j, d_j is dist_1(p_j,C), a_j is P_{vj}, and a_j^+ is max(a_j,0); tau is sqrt(delta). These are only abbreviations from def-visible-set, def-height, and the entries of P, so they do not depend on sibling node 1.1.
